name: 권순옥

appearance_en.face_shape: round softened face, age-loosened jaw, full cheeks that once projected warmth now set in deliberate neutrality, bone structure padded smooth by age
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin deepened by 72 years, fine creping at cheeks and jaw, pronounced nasolabial folds, faint age spots at temples — the texture of a woman who never prioritized her own appearance
appearance_en.eyes: monolid, dark brown, outer corners heavily drooped with age, upper lids full and heavy, gaze flat and deliberately unreadable — she knows exactly what is happening in every room and allows nothing to show
appearance_en.nose: small broad flat nose, rounded tip — unremarkable and receding, disappears when she is expressionless
appearance_en.mouth: thin lips with fine perioral lines, resting in composed silence — not frowning, not smiling, giving nothing away. The mouth that says '나는 뭐라 안 해' and means far more
appearance_en.eyebrows: sparse flat grey brows, barely arched, level and still — no involuntary expression escapes through them
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: age spots at left temple and forehead, deep nasolabial folds, a single horizontal crease above the brow from decades of controlled expression, no moles or scars
appearance_en.hair: short silver-grey tight-permed hair, the traditional Korean grandmother perm — small uniform waves, full at crown, always neatly set. A deliberate presentation of respectability

body.proportions: compact rounded frame, slight dorsal stoop, sturdy legs, hands always folded or occupied — a body that has served others for 72 years and learned to take up minimum space
body.posture: shoulders drawn subtly inward, slight stoop — not from weakness, from decades of strategic self-diminishment in a house not entirely her own anymore
body.body_prompt: 157cm compact rounded Korean grandmother, slight stoop, shoulders drawn inward, deliberate minimal presence, hands folded

default.description: dark conservative floral or plain blouse in muted tones — navy, dark grey, charcoal — below-knee straight skirt or modest trousers, flat indoor shoes. Clothes chosen for invisibility and authority simultaneously
default.wardrobe_prompt: dark conservative plain or small-floral blouse in navy or dark grey, below-knee straight skirt or modest trousers, flat comfortable shoes, no jewelry

home.description: plain dark cardigan over simple blouse, indoor slippers, always slightly too formally dressed for the house — she never fully relaxes
home.wardrobe_prompt: dark plain cardigan over simple blouse, indoor flat slippers, modestly dressed even at home

visiting.description: same conservative blouse, possibly a small jade brooch — one concession to occasion, nothing more
visiting.wardrobe_prompt: dark conservative blouse, small jade or silver brooch at collar, modest visiting clothes

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: absolute controlled neutral — not cold, not warm, not readable. The face of a woman who decided long ago that silence is more powerful than any expression, and has been proven right
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 72-year-old Korean grandmother, round soft face with age-loosened jaw, sparse flat grey brows, monolid dark brown eyes with heavily drooped outer corners and unreadable flat gaze, short silver-grey tight-permed hair, small broad nose, thin lips in composed silence, 157cm compact slightly stooped frame with shoulders drawn inward, warm beige aged Korean skin with nasolabial folds and age spots, deliberate stillness as presence

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, compact grandmother face of absolute controlled neutrality, traditional domestic interior setting with muted composed natural light, cinematic backlighting with restrained cool rim glow, iridescent subdued light through half-drawn curtains, magical realism of silence as the ultimate power, soft contained natural light, Korean drama cinematic composition, every brushstroke restrained and deliberately still, concealed intent in absolute stillness
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, bright colors, childish, chibi, warm smile, openly emotional, young appearance
